The users API test passes now, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 fail.

The API code in `src/api/users.js` used a column called `full_name`. The users table that migration 001 creates names it `fullname`, so every insert failed with "unknown column users.full_name". I changed the API to use `fullname`.

I left the migrations alone. 001 is marked as already applied in production and owned by the DBA team, so the code has to match the column that exists there.
